title: 研究項目頁讀不到真實研究工作：BFF 新增 research orchestrator 任務與執行紀錄的讀取路由

research_experiments_separation_statemen.reason: POST /bff/experiments and POST /api/v1/experiments/launch only insert a 'queued' row into research.research_experiments with no background worker or consumer to execute it. Real research work is created and executed in the research orchestrator (research.research_tasks and research.research_runs). Therefore GET /bff/research-experiments and POST /bff/experiments remain separate and unmerged from research tasks, and the frontend keeps manual experiment creation closed.

acceptance_criteria_verification.ac1_owner_http_read_and_caller_tenant_he: GET /bff/research-tasks and GET /bff/research-tasks/{task_id} use _default_http_get from ports/job_read.py and verified_caller_tenant from core/owner_reads.py; zero file reads and zero new HTTP client classes.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac2_item_shape_and_name_fallback: Each item carries id, task_id, name, objective, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at, run_count, and latest_run (run_id, adapter, dispatch_mode, status); name falls back from title to objective to task_id.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac3_owner_status_and_stub_run_truth: status is preserved directly from the owner without casting to the experiment state machine; stub runs report their real adapter='stub' and dispatch_mode='stub'.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac4_detail_route_and_non_disclosing_404: GET /bff/research-tasks/{task_id} returns the task and all of its runs; missing tasks, unscoped tasks, and tasks belonging to another tenant return identical non-disclosing 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND responses.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac5_tenant_scoping_and_excluded_unscoped: Task tenant is resolved from top-level tenant_id or constraints.tenant_id; tasks with neither are returned to no caller and counted in meta.excluded_unscoped_count; verified with two-tenant isolation test.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac6_surface_degradation_vs_healthy_empty: Unconfigured PANTHEON_RESEARCH_ORCHESTRATOR_API_URL or owner HTTP read failure returns meta.surfaces.research_tasks.status='unavailable'; healthy owner with zero tasks returns status='ok'.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac7_pagination_and_single_runs_call: GET /bff/research-tasks paginates with page_size and next_page_token and fetches runs in a single GET /api/research-orchestrator/runs call rather than 1+N.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac8_sync_def_handlers: Both route handlers are sync def and registered in test_event_loop_owner_reads_guard.py.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac9_experiments_unchanged_and_no_executo: GET /bff/research-experiments and POST /bff/experiments behave exactly as before with no research tasks merged in; research.research_experiments has no executor so manual experiment creation remains closed.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac10_real_hosted_fixtures: Tests exercise rtask-20261023-008 (constraints.tenant_id), rtask-exp-sic-30bcef4d067e4c0111fc28cfe8101a7b (top-level tenant_id, no title), and rtask-20261016-003 (neither tenant field).
